evidence: robots.txt describes the site as a Shopify storefront.
Canonical myshopify host exposes Shopify products.json, collections.json, and search/suggest.json endpoints.

dashboard.primary_limitation: The branded ridge.com storefront returned Cloudflare 403 challenge pages for homepage, sitemap, product JSON, collection JSON, and autocomplete JSON probes.
dashboard.recoverable_evidence: Catalog and autocomplete evidence was available from the canonical Shopify host ridge-wallet.myshopify.com.

crawl_health.notes: GET and HEAD requests to https://ridge.com/ returned HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge pages.
Branded-domain autocomplete JSON was blocked. Canonical Shopify search/suggest.json returned structured suggestions for representative queries. Submitted search result pages were not rendered.
Canonical Shopify collections.json returned 828 collections. Branded-domain sitemap and rendered browse pages were blocked.
Canonical Shopify search/suggest.json returned product, collection, query, and page suggestions for inspected prefixes.
Canonical Shopify products.json returned 1,175 products and 1,767 variants. Rendered product detail pages were not inspected.
Product option names and tags were observed from catalog JSON, but visible storefront facets were not rendered or verified.
Recommendation endpoints were not inspected. robots.txt disallows /recommendations/products.
Mobile rendering was not performed because direct storefront rendering was blocked in this inspection.
No competitor URLs were supplied or inspected for this Ridge report.

language.notes: The rendered storefront was blocked. Cloudflare challenge HTML used en-US, but that is not evidence of storefront language.

currency.notes: Currency was not verified from rendered UI or product variant pricing in this bounded inspection summary.

limitations: Cloudflare challenge blocked direct ridge.com homepage, sitemap, product JSON, collection JSON, autocomplete JSON, and agents.md probes.
Rendered desktop and mobile storefront UI was not captured.
Endpoint responses from the canonical Shopify host were not verified against visible UI.
Collection-product membership and parent-child browse hierarchy were not reconstructed.
Facets were inferred only from option names and tags; visible facet availability and correctness were not validated.
Submitted search result pages and ranking were not inspected.
inspection_framework_flags: The framework needs first-class handling for canonical Shopify hosts when the branded domain is blocked.
The framework needs a UCP/MCP catalog inspection path because Ridge advertises UCP discovery and catalog capabilities.
The framework needs explicit status separation between branded-domain rendering evidence and canonical-platform API evidence.
